Most Shopify SEO checklists run to 40 or 50 steps.

A store owner with orders to pack won't finish that. So I cut my Shopify SEO checklist to 25 fixes, sorted by day, Monday to Friday. Most take 5 to 20 minutes.

Only have one hour this week? Do these 5 first:

Remove the password.

Shopify admin > Online Store > Preferences > Store access.

If Private mode is on, visitors and Google see a password page instead of your store. Nothing ranks behind a password.

Submit your sitemap.

Search Console > Sitemaps. Paste sitemap.xml and submit.

Shopify builds it for you and keeps it up to date, so you only submit the main one. A healthy result shows status Success.

Check your key pages are indexed.

Use URL Inspection on your homepage, your top 3 collections and your top 5 products.

"Crawled, currently not indexed" usually means the page looks thin or too similar to another. "Discovered" means Google hasn't got to it yet.

Give every key page its own title tag.

Open a product, scroll to Search engine listing, click the pencil. No two pages should share a title.

Keep it under about 60 characters: product type + key detail + brand.

Test your Core Web Vitals.

Run your homepage, one collection and one product page through PageSpeed Insights on mobile.

Google's good targets: LCP 2.5 seconds or less, INP 200 ms or less, CLS 0.1 or less.

The other 20 fixes cover duplicate pages, collection text, speed, structured data and tracking sales from Google.

Write down what you changed and the date. In 4 weeks, compare.

Which of these 5 would your store fail first?
